1.title: How to add a product to the inventory?
steps: Go to the Inventory module in the side panel.
Select "Products" and click Add product.
Fill in the form: name, price and initial stock.
Save the changes — the product will appear in the catalog immediately.

2.title: How to connect the WhatsApp chatbot?
steps: Go to the Chatbot module in the configuration panel.
Press "Connect WhatsApp" to display the QR code.
Scan the QR code from your WhatsApp Business app on your phone.
Done! The chatbot is now active and can receive and respond to messages.

3.title: How to validate a payment from the dashboard?
steps: Access the Orders module from the side panel.
Filter orders with status "Awaiting receipt".
Open the order and review the receipt image sent by the client.
Press Approve payment if valid, or Reject with a reason.

4.title: How to manage expiry dates in lots?
steps: Go to the Inventory module and select the Lots tab.
Review the "Expiry date" column — lots expiring soon are highlighted.
Critical lots generate stock alerts automatically on the home page.
Edit a lot to adjust the date or available quantity.

5.title: How to check the daily cash summary?
steps: Go to the Sales module from the side panel.
The cash summary appears in the right side panel.
It shows the Day total, Cash and Yape/Plin separately.
It updates automatically with each completed sale.

6.title: What to do if the chatbot disconnects?
steps: Go to the Chatbot module — you will see a "Session expired" notice in red.
Press "Reconnect" to start the reconnection.
Scan the new QR code from your WhatsApp Business app.
The chatbot will resume its activity normally.

7.title: Can the chatbot send receipts automatically?
steps: The chatbot receives receipts sent by clients via WhatsApp.
It displays them automatically in the Orders module of the dashboard.
The merchant must validate them manually — the system does not approve them automatically.
After validation, the client receives an automatic confirmation via WhatsApp.

8.title: How to validate a payment?
steps: Access the Orders module.
Select the order pending validation.
Review the receipt attached by the client.
Approve or reject the payment accordingly.

9.title: How to view the daily sales report?
steps: Go to the Sales module from the sidebar.
The daily summary appears in the Cash widget: total, cash and digital.
You can check the sales history in the History section.
Data updates in real time with each completed sale.

10.title: How to manage my subscription plan?
steps: Go to the Subscription module from the sidebar.
Review your active plan, included features and renewal date.
To change your plan, click Manage plan and choose the new one.
You will receive a confirmation email when the change is complete.
